ids: operation semantics;native-save coverage;52 nonprefixed acts;unresolved replay
reviews.classification: complete historical native adapter/constraint/content receipt with later integration and save-contract findings
reviews.disposition: The registry preserves all503 incumbent command definitions byte-identically and adds explicit read/prepare/wake/check-time/sit/secure/wait mechanisms over existing owners. Seeded stock, custody ownership, actual clock-display facts and explicit numeric wait duration are required where the mechanism needs them; no prose-generated stock, native sleep cancellation, fatigue recovery or new clock is implied by labels. Awake/rest/custody facts are bounded fallback semantics, not missing native consumers silently implemented. All seven operation families have native pending and settled persistence evidence, but no live content adoption or new desktop route. Resume1 scans52 reviewed rows, finds zero invalid boolean/string fact effects, and reproduces the reported row successfully with supplied precondition, including the full pack. It independently repairs nonprefixed registered place-act exact-definition lookup and proves tamper rejection. This does not establish the cause of the coordinator's original settled-save failure, which remains unreproduced because preceding replay state/time was not captured. T2's later journey-destination membership diagnosis is a distinct demonstrated failure path, not proof that every act save failure is solved. Preserve original replay capture/persist exception as the diagnostic need, with dated timeout/rerun and scanner collisions explicit.
